scientific_limitations: Counts field-linear unital algebra automorphisms with square equal to the identity, in characteristic two, and only for cubic total-degree truncation. Does not classify all conjugacy classes or invariant rings. title: Characteristic-two involutions of multivariable cubic jet automorphism groups
